title: Guava keeps the last put across a key collision
summary: Two distinct String keys with equal hashes can displace a bucket entry when a later put repeats a key.

change.description: Two distinct String keys with equal hashes can displace a bucket entry when a later put repeats a key.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 121 inputs on each revision. parent mismatches were 2 for size, 10 for lookup, 2 for entries. fix mismatches were 0 for size, 0 for lookup, 0 for entries.
